text.description_html:
Don-Jo PMLP-111-630, Outswing Door Stainless Security Pin Mortise LatchGuard

This satin stainless steel security door latch protector features an anti spread security pin. The 1/2" solid stainless pin is welded to the back side of the security plate leaving no visible point of attack from the outside. When the door is closed the security pin embeds into the door frame to prevent spreading of the door from the frame.

It is 11" high and designed specifically for outswing doors (door opens out of the room or building). For use with mortise latch sets on residential or commercial door applications.

Protect your entry doors from tampering and latch prying with this stainless steel security latch protector plate. No special tools required for installation. Packaged with mounting hardware.

Non-Handed, reversible for left or right hand outswinging doors. Fits doors with standard 2-1-2" to 2-3/4" backset.

Specifications for the Don-Jo PMLP-111-630 Security Pin Latch Guard:

  • Plate Height: 11"
  • Plate Width: 3"
  • Plate Thickness: 12 Gauge (.104")
  • Security Pin: .313" x .500"
  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Offset: 1/4" (.250")
  • Non-Handed (reversible)
  • Fasteners: 4 each 5/16-18 x 2-1/4" Carriage bolt with Acorn nuts and washers.
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Don-Jo PMLP-111-630 Security Plate Dimensions (PDF)

*Sold Individually.
